algorithmicsuperintelligence_openevolve/.check_mlir_tools: check which MLIR tools like mlir-opt and mlir-translate are available on the system
algorithmicsuperintelligence_openevolve/.test_mlir_translate: test MLIR to LLVM IR translation using a simple floating point addition function

algorithmicsuperintelligence_openevolve/.suggest_fixes: suggest fixes to enable real MLIR execution including tool installation and simulation improvements

algorithmicsuperintelligence_openevolve/.run_fix_tensor_shapes: run the script to fix tensor.expand_shape syntax in the MLIR self-attention file
algorithmicsuperintelligence_openevolve/.run_add_output_shape: run the script to add missing output_shape attributes to tensor.expand_shape ops
algorithmicsuperintelligence_openevolve/.review_add_output_shape: review the add_output_shape function that extracts tensor dimensions from MLIR output types
algorithmicsuperintelligence_openevolve/.refactor_fix_tensor_shapes: refactor the script to accept an input MLIR file path via command-line arguments

algorithmicsuperintelligence_openevolve/.run_mlir_lowering_pipeline: run the MLIR lowering pipeline to convert an MLIR file to LLVM-compatible IR using mlir-opt passes

algorithmicsuperintelligence_openevolve/.find_available_passes: find and list all available MLIR conversion passes for arith, func, llvm, std, and scf dialects
algorithmicsuperintelligence_openevolve/.test_lowering_passes: test different lowering pass combinations on an MLIR file to find sequences that successfully translate to LLVM IR
algorithmicsuperintelligence_openevolve/.create_lowered_file: create a fully lowered MLIR file by applying a pass sequence and optionally save the LLVM IR output

algorithmicsuperintelligence_openevolve/.run_mlir_syntax_tests: run the mlir syntax test script to verify baseline attention and tiling pass syntax
algorithmicsuperintelligence_openevolve/.test_mlir_baseline_syntax: test the mlir baseline attention syntax using mlir-opt to parse affine maps and linalg generic ops
algorithmicsuperintelligence_openevolve/.test_linalg_tiling_pass: test the linalg tiling pass by running mlir-opt with a canonicalize and cse pipeline
algorithmicsuperintelligence_openevolve/.verify_mlir_installation: verify mlir-opt is installed and working by running the mlir syntax test script
algorithmicsuperintelligence_openevolve/.validate_attention_mlir_program: validate an mlir program that implements scaled dot-product attention with query key and value tensors
